title: Rebuilding Trust After Betrayal
paragraphs: After discovering that a close friend had shared personal information he had explicitly asked her to keep confidential, Rayyan faced the difficult decision of whether the friendship was worth attempting to repair at all.

Rather than immediately cutting off contact entirely, he arranged a direct conversation where he explained specifically how the breach of trust had affected him, avoiding vague accusations in favor of concrete examples.

His friend, genuinely remorseful rather than defensive, acknowledged the mistake without minimizing its impact, which Rayyan considered essential before he could reasonably consider rebuilding any level of trust between them.

Over the following months, trust returned gradually rather than immediately, with Rayyan cautiously sharing smaller confidences first before eventually returning to the openness that had characterized their friendship previously.
